environment: Disposable restored local database with migrations 127-134 and source-equivalent application ACL on the clone. Actual candidate Next page and history API with eleven synthetic private revisions; clone dropped after verification.

results.api: The real history API returned ten revisions with hasMore=true on offset 0, then the oldest reconstructed revision with hasMore=false on offset 10.
results.actualPage: At 390x760 and 1366x900, the real page showed the first ten versions. A one-shot HTTP 503 was injected only for the second-page response; the page showed an error, hid the first-page versions, kept page 2 selected, and retried the same offset against the real API. The oldest revision and its reconstruction disclosure then appeared.
results.failureInjection: Response-boundary interception for one request only; it does not prove that the production database or service naturally returned a 503.

limits: The fixture used synthetic revision rows and no original file. It does not verify production loading, natural service failure, exact historical source provenance, or all G13 entries.
